text:
maria: CI turned red on main, only the db-integration shard is failing. 2/3 runs flaky with a Postgres connection timeout. can someone requeue just that shard? this is blocking PR #482
kevin: you can run the local helper to rerun just the shard without rebuilding images:
`./scripts/ci rerun --shard=db-integration --no-image`
kevin: that will skip image builds and preserve cache layers. or as a GH comment we support: `@ci-bot retry db-integration` (requires exact shard name)
maria: awesome — do i need to set any special env/secrets? it failed while acquiring the test-db lease last time
kevin: usually no. if it failed during test-db setup you can clear the lock in sandbox: `kubectl -n test delete pod test-db-lock` then rerun. only use `--rebuild` if artifacts are corrupted
ashley: fwiw if it keeps flaking we should bisect the commit range quickly: `./scripts/ci bisect --shard=db-integration --start SHA1 --end SHA2` to narrow down when the flakiness started
sam: quick alternative: comment on the PR `@ci-bot rerun db-integration --skip-imagebuild` and the bot will enqueue the targeted job
ci-bot: requeued job 987654 for PR #482 (shard: db-integration) — flags: skip-imagebuild
maria: kicked it, CI picked up the job, looks like it's running now :crossed_fingers:
kevin: if it passes please add a short note in the PR so we have context for future flakes. if it fails again paste the failing test id and a short log snippet
maria: confirmed — job passed. thanks everyone :tada:
kevin: :thumbsup: ping @platform if this becomes frequent, might need infra tweaks to the ephemeral test-db
ashley: noted, will add a short tracking ticket if we see >3 flakes in 24h
sam: nice, closing this thread — glad it was a quick unblock
